preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of nodes N in each test case must be between 1 and 1000000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] <= 1000000000 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All node values A_i must be between 0 and 1000000000.
The total number of nodes across all test cases must not exceed 1000000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum security of the tree after performing valid operations.
